history.content: hi. idk why im even opening this honestly. i think im just. ok this morning i got a call from the clinic and they said my last scan came back clear and ive been sitting here for like an hour just kind of stunned
That sounds like a very still kind of stunned, especially after hearing the scan came back clear. If you want, you can just stay with that here for a moment.

yeah stunned is the word. its weird because i thought id be crying or jumping around or something. but its more like. my whole body just kind of exhaled? like ive been holding my shoulders up near my ears for two years and i didnt even notice til now
That exhale after two years of holding yourself up sounds real, and the surprise of not crying or jumping makes sense too. Is it mostly in your shoulders and chest, or somewhere else as well?

shoulders and chest yeah. and like the back of my jaw, ive apparently been clenching it this whole time. it started w a lump i found in 2024 and then it was biopsies and the in between weeks waiting for results which honestly were the worst part. the not knowing. you make up a whole future where its bad and then you have to unmake it
That waiting sounds like it wore a path right through your shoulders, chest, and jaw.

right thats exactly it. wore a path. and the thing is now im almost scared to relax into it?? like part of me is going dont get too comfortable, what if the next scan. theres always a next scan. its every 6 months now. so this clear is real but its also just. a temporary clear. and i dont know how to hold both at the same time, the relief and the knowing it could come back
I’m holding both with you, the relief and the part that won’t fully let go because there’s always a next scan. Does it feel more like they sit side by side, or like one is guarding the other?

oh. guarding. yeah the scared part is guarding the relief i think. like if i let myself be fully happy then ill have further to fall next time. so i keep one foot out the door. my partner kept saying tonight we should celebrate, lets get the nice wine, and i just couldnt. i wanted to be there w them but i had this wall up
That wall up makes a lot of sense, especially with one foot still out the door. It sounds like the scared part is keeping the relief from tipping into something that feels too risky.

i think i want to let the wall down a little. just not all the way. like maybe i can have the wine w them and still keep the 6 month thing in the back of my mind, it doesnt have to be all or nothing right. its just hard because for two years my whole job was bracing. thats the muscle i built. and now somebody is telling me i can put it down for a bit and i dont totally trust that yet

That bracing muscle sounds very well trained, and it makes sense that putting it down would not feel automatic yet. We can leave it here with that, or stay with what it would mean to trust it a little.

can we stay just a sec more. i think what trusting it a little would mean is. letting tonight actually be a good night. like not saving my happiness for some imaginary day when theres no more scans because that day might never come. the clears are the life now. theyre not the waiting room before the real thing, they ARE the thing. god that just landed kind of hard typing it out
That landed with weight, and I’m glad you said it out loud. We can let it rest here for tonight.
yeah. lets let it rest. i think im gonna go find my partner and open that wine. the clears are the life now. im gonna try to hold onto that one
That feels like a good place to pause. I hope the wine and your partner give the night some room.
thank you. really. this helped more than i expected. night
Good night. I’m glad this space was useful, and I hope tomorrow feels a little gentler.
